# Interfaces

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 5 · Interfaces

Parent page: [Cognitive Workspace](../0-home/home.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:2c91eae6dad930c0 -->
The system exposes no formal interface description: there is no OpenAPI or JSON Schema source in the repository, since all business logic is published as Firebase callable functions. Interface specifications are therefore planned as detailed deliverables produced by a dedicated session, each grounded on the workspace nodes listed in its card.
<!-- codeforge:body:end -->

## Contents

- [Callable function catalog](iface-callables.md) — Specify each callable function: input, output, errors, role required and secrets, grouped by domain. Source declared only in code (functions/backend/src/index.ts).
- [Firestore data model](iface-data-model.md) — Describe collections, sub-collections, key fields and access rules, including the separation of private data and the catalog plus index model of attachments.
- [External integrations and email contracts](iface-integrations.md) — Specify the contracts with reCAPTCHA Enterprise, the Telegram notification channel and the Trigger Email extension, including the email templates registry.
